title: Does the Linguistic Register of Thinking Matter? Wenyan as a Compact Reasoning Register for Chinese LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visible reasoning traces of Chinese reasoning-oriented LLMs are typically written in modern vernacular Chinese, which may be verbose under limited decoding budgets. We ask whether the linguistic register of reasoning can be used to improve efficiency. We propose Wenyan Thinking, which emits intermediate reasoning in Classical Chinese (wenyanwen) while retaining a short direct-answer output. Starting from modern-Chinese reasoning traces, we rewrite only the reasoning field into wenyan and fine-tune Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 on the rewritten supervision. To distinguish register shift from generic compression, we construct a compact modern-Chinese control using the same source data, teacher family, base model, and SFT recipe. Across budget-sensitive evaluations on MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH, CEVAL, and AGIEval-CN, Wenyan Thinking substantially reduces reasoning length and missing-answer rates under constrained decoding. Compact rewriting explains much

translated_title: 思维的语言语体重要吗？文言文作为中文大语言模型的紧凑推理语体
translated_abstract: 中文推理导向大语言模型的可见推理轨迹通常以现代白话文书写，这在有限的解码预算下可能显得冗长。我们探讨推理所用语言语体能否用于提升效率。我们提出文言思维，该方法以文言文输出中间推理过程，同时保留简短的直接答案输出。从现代中文推理轨迹出发，我们仅将推理字段改写为文言文，并基于改写后的监督数据微调 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507。为了区分语体转换与一般性文本压缩，我们使用相同的源数据、教师模型家族、基座模型和SFT训练配方，构建了一个紧凑的现代中文对照组。在 MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH、CEVAL 和 AGIEval-CN 上的预算敏感评估中，文言思维在受限解码条件下显著降低了推理长度和答案缺失率。紧凑改写在很大程度上解释了……
tldr: 该论文提出“文言思维”方法，让中文大语言模型用文言文作为紧凑的推理语体，在受限解码预算下大幅缩短推理长度并降低答案缺失率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Wenyan Thinking, which uses Classical Chinese as a compact reasoning register for Chinese LLMs, substantially reducing reasoning length and missing-answer rates under constrained decoding budgets.
